title: Subpolynomial query complexity for log-concave sampling

result.label: Subpolynomial query complexity for log-concave sampling
result.statement: For C 2 potentials with a supplied minimizer and I ^2V 2I, proves that sampling within total variation 1/10 requires only C d^ exact value-and-gradient queries for every fixed ε > 0. The bound holds on every run, with unrestricted computation between queries. A logarithmic lower bound also holds, so the optimal power-law exponent in this oracle model is zero.
